note: An old page left open keeps the old limits; the server must still refuse
The same person signed in as staff on one device and the owner on another: each device follows its own role
A plan priced ₹0 or ₹1: the 10% floor rounds in paise; a free plan is the owner’s only
The 31-day and never-ahead limits are counted from India’s day; a device on another clock or a sheet open over midnight sits on the edge
A sale kept on the device and sent days later must still meet the 31-day limit when it reaches the server
The sheet words are plain text in the code, not passed through the translate helper used on the member page; whether another language reaches them was not checked
The refusal sentences are long and sit under half-width boxes
